notes.title: Update notes: 1/13/2022
notes.content:
Small changes made after launch.

[list]
[*] Fixed clipping glitch where the player would get stuck in the ceiling when hit by an enemy while directly underneath a solid object.
[*] The enter key no longer re-pauses the game after pressing the resume button in the pause menu.
[/list]
